_readme: Thermal Print - the whole frame remapped to a two-colour thermal/badge printer: paper white, red ink and black ink, ordered-dithered. No block changes, tints or fog: the world, lighting and other mods render untouched; this is purely an output-stage remap (vanilla post chain, applied after the world and hand, before the HUD). Colour you 'see' is your brain filling it in (memory colour, simultaneous contrast, Land/retinex). All tunables are uniforms in assets/thermal/shaders/post/thermal.json - edit and press F3+T.
name: Thermal Print
description: Two-colour thermal printer: paper white, red and black ink only. Your brain supplies the rest.
